methodology.coldModels: Language/model bytes predownloaded, served from localhost; browser contexts fresh. Network downloads excluded from initialization timings.
methodology.preprocessing: Scale min(2,2048/maxEdge), white background, PNG. Adaptive recognizer is the shipped implementation.
methodology.subset: Nine multiline screenshots, four single-line crops, one no-text image. Synthetic diagnostic corpus; no real-world accuracy claim.
methodology.scoring: NFKC, lowercase, remove punctuation, collapse whitespace. Micro Levenshtein CER/WER; exact whole-word term matching.
methodology.florenceResume: Seven cases before navigation interruption; remaining seven after fresh initialization. Two warm repetitions per case retained; HMR disabled in final runner.
methodology.selectedTranscript: Original text retained; a more confident differing contrast reading appended. CER/WER include the additional reading.
